paragraphs: 克里歐門王國首都歐倫市，王國的宮殿內，熱鬧的晚宴上，外地來的冒險者們桌上擺滿了空酒瓶。在現任女王瑪瓦和他的女兒烏瑪公主的款待下，冒險者們和前來參與的賓客們各個吃飽喝足。
夢想完成「大幹一票」儀式的狗頭人希岡、愛耍酷的荒咬薄刃、身材彪悍的黑毛貓人阿嘿尼，以及此時已經酩酊大醉的妖精泰坦妮亞，在這充滿矮人的宴會廳顯得格格不入，但此時他們是宴會的焦點。雖然喝醉了的他們已經不記得女王的指示，但是隔天，他們被指派前往一座礦脈，去尋找一件寶物。
在女王的安排下，四名冒險者住進了王宮二樓的兩間雙人房。
一早醒來，冒險者們的房門被重重的敲擊。一名矮人催促著冒險者們趕緊出發。這名名為札克的矮人是他們這次任務的嚮導。冒險者們連離開房間都花了不少時間，不耐煩的札克連早餐都不讓冒險者們吃，便把他們趕上馬車，準備出發。
馬車上，札克翻開通往後車廂的座椅，一個機器人便翻身而出。札克介紹這名機器人，名為啵啵V，是他的夥伴，這次出任務也會協助帶領大家在礦脈內前進。接著，札克也從倉庫番出了不少啤酒，分給冒險者們。
在冒險者們的詢問下，札克和啵啵V簡單說明了這次的任務，是要從礦脈內帶回一件寶物：龍之球。
天色漸暗，馬車終於停在礦脈外。大家在礦脈口簡單吃點東西後，便進到礦脈內。啵啵V走在前頭，似乎對於裡面的環境十分清楚，遇到路口便直接轉彎。然而，走到其中一個路口時，卻突然無法判斷該走哪一側。殿後的札克繞到最前面，最終選擇了左轉，而啵啵V則改為殿後。

其中一處岔路口，札克向右轉，但走在第二的阿嘿尼的直覺告訴他應該要向左走才對，況且，一路喝酒的札克看起來判斷力也不太好。阿嘿尼想向走在最後的啵啵V確認，卻發現啵啵V似乎故障了。最後，阿嘿尼決定向左走。不久後，跟隨著阿嘿尼的眾人聽見了後方傳來了慘叫聲。回頭，大家發現札克竟然掉入了陷阱。努力拉出後，發現陷阱內的長矛已刺入了札克的身體內，他已失去了生命跡象。荒咬薄刃翻了翻札克的衣服，找到了一張紙條，上面有他看不懂的文字，以及畫了一顆蛋：淡淡的藍色，上面有著紫色的紋路。在希岡的解讀下，這是龍語，寫著「布萊茲大人」。
眾人苦惱著，此時啵啵V卻突然恢復正常，並繞到最前面，要為大家帶路。然而，啵啵V走了好幾個小時，希岡卻發現看見了自己丟在地上作為記號的碎骨頭—啵啵V似乎在重複相同的道路。冒險者們決定先暫時停下來，讓啵啵V繼續繞，反正如果他一直在重複相同的路徑，肯定也會繞回來的。同時，希岡也聞到了這裡除了他們與啵啵V外，還有其他生物的味道，而那似乎是他所熟悉的生物：龍。
過了超過預期的時間，冒險者們發現啵啵V竟然沒有再次出現，於是決定繼續往前。憑著冒險者們的直覺，他們選擇了和之前不同的岔路，走了一陣子，似乎聽見了前方有聲響。等待後，他們發現似乎是啵啵V朝著他們走了過來。在啵啵V的解釋後，大家還是跟著他繼續前進了。然而，這次啵啵V走的速度有點快，大家要趕上十分辛苦。

一段時間後，除了希岡外，大家已經跟不太上了。希岡則刻意和啵啵V保持一點距離，以偷偷觀察他的行為。他聽見了啵啵V嘴裡似乎碎念著什麼，但是他聽不懂。啵啵V進入了一個圓形的廣場，停在廣場的另一端。希岡躲在廣場邊緣偷看，其他冒險者則在外頭的長廊等待。接著，希岡看見啵啵V前方黑暗的空間亮起來一雙眼，一頭成年藍龍飛了出來，鑽過希岡正上方的門口，飛越長廊，停在其他冒險者背後。藍龍發出了一陣聲響，但冒險者們完全聽不懂。接著，在一陣光芒下，藍龍化身成了一名身著藍裝的藍眼女子，用著普通語，叫冒險者們通通進到廣場去。

在藍龍飛向長廊時，希岡看見了原本藍龍所處的位置，有成堆的龍蛋—和荒咬薄刃發現的紙條上畫得一模一樣。同時，啵啵V伸長了他的機械手臂，取出了一顆蛋，置於他的頭上，但竟然滑順的融入了他的身子，原本人形的啵啵V此刻竟產生了變化，除了身高變高、身外披了一層淺藍色帶有紫色斑紋的皮膚外，背後也長出了一對翅膀。希岡詢問啵啵V這是怎麼回事，啵啵V只回應了自己現在已經進化成了啵啵W，便展翅飛去，穿過了長廊、冒險者與藍龍，消失了。

在藍龍的要求下，其他冒險者們也回到了廣場。藍龍向冒險者們詢問他們來到這裡的目的，但大家的回應（不小心繞進來這裡）不滿意，執意覺得大家肯定是為了龍蛋而來。藍龍透過龍語，向希岡提出了交易：只要一個冒險者留下，他就讓剩下三名安全離開；兩名留下，剩下兩名安全離開，還能帶走一顆蛋；三名留下，唯一離開的一名可以帶走兩顆蛋；四名留下，便通通殺死。希岡表示自己願意留下來，請藍龍放其他人走。接著，藍龍便用通用語向其他冒險者們說明自己和希岡提出的交易，但其他冒險者們都不願意留下來。藍龍朝著廣場天花板施放了閃電，讓電在廣場頂端不斷穿梭。藍龍透過心靈感應，一一向冒險者們詢問是否願意留下來，不願回答的話，他便讓閃電從上方打下來。然而，除了希岡外，大家都不想留下來。於是，藍龍便依約讓其他三名冒險者向外走去。
希岡鬆了一口氣，但他沒想到，藍龍竟然化身成了龍，朝著長廊飛去，朝著剛被放走的三名夥伴各打了閃電。荒咬薄刃和泰坦妮亞當場喪命，阿嘿尼則全身焦黑（雖然原本就是黑毛），奄奄一息。看傻了的希岡完全沒想到事態的發展，他看著藍龍飛了回來，遞給了他一顆龍蛋，同時讓他坐上自己的背，承諾他會帶他離開這裡，接著藍龍便載著希岡飛到了礦脈口，藍龍也化成了人形。
礦脈外，馬車停在原處。藍龍詢問希岡是否會駕馬車，希岡點了點頭，坐上馬車，藍龍則抱著蛋，坐上了馬車。然而，緊張的希岡讓藍龍不甚滿意，於是藍龍自己下了車，將龍蛋抱給希岡，自己駕起了馬車，將希岡載回歐倫市，停在了王宮前。
藍龍下了馬車，為希岡開了車門。希岡看見正在王宮門口等待他們的瑪瓦女王。女王向他了解了其他夥伴的狀況，並詢問起這名藍裝的女子。藍龍表示自己是在路邊被希岡救起的。
女王將藍龍和希岡帶入王宮內，將希岡帶入了一間寶物室，裡面儘是黃金與各種寶物。女王讓希岡隨意挑選，只要他能雙手帶的走的都能拿取，接著女王便帶藍龍走了。希岡還處在驚慌的狀態下，什麼寶物都沒有想拿走，只是靜靜的看著。不久後，烏瑪公主跑了進來，看見希岡什麼都沒拿，覺得真奇怪。但希岡只是默默的走了出去，然後離開了王宮。
被燒焦的阿嘿尼緩慢地爬向了廣場，他知道自己離死亡也不遠了。終於來到了廣場，阿嘿尼趴了下來。而在他閉上雙眼前，他看見一顆龍蛋掉落了下來。他似乎聽見了蛋殼碎裂的聲響。

In the royal palace at Orun, capital of the Kingdom of Chryomen, empty wine bottles covered the visiting adventurers’ table at a lively banquet. Queen Marva and her daughter, Princess Uma, had ensured that adventurers and guests alike were thoroughly fed and drunk.

The kobold Sigom, who dreamed of completing the “Big Score” rite; the ever-cool Wildbite Thinblade; the powerfully built black-furred catfolk Aheni; and the thoroughly intoxicated elf Titania looked out of place in a banquet hall full of dwarves, yet they were the center of attention. Too drunk to remember the queen’s instructions, they learned the next day that they had been assigned to retrieve a treasure from a mine.
At the queen’s arrangement, the four adventurers stayed in two double rooms on the palace’s second floor.

Early the next morning, heavy pounding shook their doors. A dwarf urged them to depart at once. His name was Zach, and he would guide their mission. The adventurers took so long merely leaving their rooms that an impatient Zach denied them breakfast, herded them into the carriage, and set off.

Inside the carriage, Zach flipped open a seat leading to the rear compartment, and a robot tumbled out. He introduced it as BoBo-V, his partner, who would help guide everyone through the mine. Zach then hauled several beers from storage and passed them around.
At the adventurers’ request, Zach and BoBo-V briefly explained their task: recover a treasure called Dragon’s Orb from the mine.

Dusk was falling when the carriage finally stopped outside the mine. After a quick meal at the entrance, the group went in. BoBo-V led with obvious familiarity, turning decisively at each junction—until he suddenly reached one where he could no longer choose a direction. Zach came forward from the rear, selected the left passage, and sent BoBo-V to bring up the rear.

At another fork, Zach turned right, but Aheni, second in line, instinctively felt they should go left. Zach had also been drinking throughout the journey, and his judgment looked unreliable. Aheni tried to confirm with BoBo-V at the back, only to find that the robot seemed to have malfunctioned. He ultimately took the left path. Soon afterward, the group following Aheni heard a scream behind them. They turned and found that Zach had fallen into a trap. When they finally pulled him free, they saw that its spears had pierced his body and killed him. Wildbite Thinblade searched Zach’s clothes and found a note bearing unreadable writing and a drawing of a pale blue egg patterned in purple. Sigom identified the writing as Draconic: “Lord Blaze.”

As the group struggled with what to do, BoBo-V abruptly returned to normal, moved to the front, and offered to lead. After several hours, however, Sigom spotted a bone fragment he had dropped as a marker. BoBo-V had been leading them in circles. The adventurers stopped and let the robot continue alone, reasoning that if it kept repeating the route it would eventually return. Meanwhile, Sigom caught the scent of another creature besides the party and BoBo-V—one he knew well: a dragon.

BoBo-V did not reappear when expected, so the adventurers pressed on. Following their instincts, they chose a different branch and soon heard something ahead. After waiting, they saw BoBo-V approaching. They accepted his explanation and followed again, but this time he moved so quickly that keeping pace became exhausting.

Before long, only Sigom could keep up. He deliberately hung back to watch BoBo-V in secret and heard the robot muttering something he could not understand. BoBo-V entered a circular plaza and stopped at its far side. Sigom observed from the edge while the others waited in the outer corridor. A pair of eyes lit within the darkness before BoBo-V. An adult blue dragon flew out, passed directly over Sigom through the entrance, crossed the corridor, and landed behind the other adventurers. It made sounds no one understood. Then light flared, and the dragon transformed into a blue-eyed woman dressed in blue, ordering everyone in Common to enter the plaza.

As the dragon flew into the corridor, Sigom saw heaps of dragon eggs where it had been—identical to the egg drawn on Wildbite Thinblade’s note. BoBo-V extended a mechanical arm, took an egg, and placed it atop his head. The egg flowed smoothly into his body. The humanoid robot grew taller, acquired pale blue skin with purple markings, and sprouted wings. When Sigom asked what was happening, the robot replied only that he had evolved into BoBo-W. He spread his wings, flew through the corridor past the adventurers and dragon, and vanished.

At the blue dragon’s demand, the other adventurers returned to the plaza. She asked why they had come, but rejected their answer—that they had wandered in by accident—and insisted they wanted the eggs. In Draconic, she offered Sigom a bargain: if one adventurer stayed, the other three could leave safely; if two stayed, the other two could leave with one egg; if three stayed, the sole survivor could take two eggs; and if all four stayed, she would kill them all. Sigom volunteered to remain and asked her to release his companions. The dragon repeated the bargain to the others in Common, but none volunteered. She fired lightning into the ceiling, where it continued to arc overhead, then questioned each adventurer telepathically. If one refused to answer, she struck with lightning. Still, no one but Sigom agreed to stay, so the dragon honored the bargain and let the other three leave.

Sigom relaxed, never expecting the blue dragon to resume her true form, fly into the corridor, and blast each newly released companion with lightning. Wildbite Thinblade and Titania died instantly. Aheni, blackened from head to toe despite already having black fur, barely clung to life. Stunned by the betrayal, Sigom watched the dragon return and give him an egg. She invited him onto her back, promised to take him away, and carried him to the mine entrance before transforming into a woman again.

The carriage still waited outside. The dragon asked if Sigom could drive; he nodded, climbed up, and took the reins while she boarded with the egg. His nervous driving dissatisfied her, however, so she stepped down, handed him the egg, and drove them back to Orun herself, stopping before the palace.

The blue dragon opened Sigom’s carriage door. Queen Marva was waiting at the palace entrance. She asked what had happened to the other adventurers and who the woman in blue was. The dragon claimed Sigom had rescued her beside the road.

The queen brought both of them inside and led Sigom into a treasury filled with gold and treasures. She told him he could take anything he could carry in both hands, then departed with the blue dragon. Still in shock, Sigom wanted none of it and simply stood staring. Princess Uma soon ran in and found it strange that he had taken nothing. Sigom silently walked out and left the palace.

The burned Aheni slowly crawled toward the plaza, knowing death was near. When he finally reached it, he lay down. Before closing his eyes, he saw a dragon egg fall. He thought he heard its shell crack.
